text.content:
A character with this derangement is prone to experiencing fits of anger with little provocation. While the two bear certain resemblances, this state is quite different from frenzy - frenzy is the instincts of the vampiric Beast, while Crimson Rage is a character's own feelings of helplessness and inadequacy. Characters with Crimson Rage are not protected from being pushed over the edge into frenzy while insane, however.

Trigger/Effect: Whenever this derangement is active, the character gains the Negative Traits: Violent x2 and Impatient.
